notes:
## Content and source state
This leaf continues the discussion of restricted prospaces: (68) describes the corresponding prospace for X′, followed by a union identity, a four-case description of V_{j,l}^{X′}, and a restricted union over j≤l. A starred marginal note explicitly qualifies the empty-intersection claim for incomparable indices by requiring normality of the open subsets of X and gives metrizable X as an example. A second marginal note, headed underlined NB, contains the phrase équiv. d’homotopie, and a genuine three-object diagram with definition relations. The lower paragraph begins the analysis of intersections and their supporting drapeaux. These are the author’s statements; this transcription does not certify their proofs.

There is no title, date or dark authorial page number on the leaf. H’s reference to an earlier numbered leaf is editorial and is not copied into the transcription. The handwritten formula labels on this page are (68) and (69); (69) belongs to the main restricted-union display. A thin grey other-hand foliation 82 is preserved as a margin inscription. No typescript or independent drawing occurs.

## Mathematical and palaeographic rereadings
- The entire four-line (68) was inspected on a crop because of M0673. The X, upper star, serifed I and prime are visible, so X_{I′}^* is resolved. The same notation in the next line confirms the local letter form. The repeated X_i′ on successive lines is retained; C’s comma after the first occurrence is not visible.
- The rest of proespace is readable. Its tall initial and transverse crossing leave a local uncertainty between a retraced p and an older canceled t; the current transcription preserves proespace versus canceled-t-plus-proespace without certifying the older letter.
- The whole union identity was cropped together with its annotation. A separate tight correction crop shows old j cancelled and replacement l above it, resolving M0674. The two upright strokes between the annotation and overbrace are preserved vertically as an equality relation. The annotation says X_L^* car X_L^* ouvert dans X′ without an added est.
- The full cases expression was reread for the standard/standart doubts. Both words end in d, resolving M0675–M0676 to standard. All case indices and inequalities, the empty-set sign, the footnote star, J∩L, and the extra consequence line were inspected. The brace ends above the final parenthesis, so that parenthesis is placed outside cases. Reading these relations was not a proof check.
- Rotating the upper margin crop makes sous réserve que, soient normaux, p.ex. and métrisable readable. Four terminal stops remain four stops. The note is attached by its star to non comparables, not to a different case.
- The main-text donc before the restricted union is crossed by the long descender of the slanted marginal formule. Following that stroke shows it is not a cancellation. The separate crop preserves this overlap for blind review.
- The full marginal note and its complete diagram were inspected before resolving Sur, équiv. and (h). The arrow has a plain tail; its tilde is above the shaft and beneath the h label. The left equality is vertical with déf at the left; the right definition is attached below an underbrace with parenthesized déf under the equals. All objects, subscripts, upper L and X_L^* were reread.
- The reminder’s se rappellera is supported by the separate se group and the paired descending p and ascending l strokes. The j,j and final j indices were checked against the page’s angular j forms, with no change made to the written indices.
- The bottom corrections were followed independently of grammar: (distincts) attaches after termes; ceux-ci replaces the cancelled qui immediately before sont. The first moins is included in the long cancellation. The deleted de/dont cannot be resolved through its heavy strike and is left narrow; likewise et où at the end of (68) and pour after the restricted union retain their struck-text doubts.

## Explicit qualifications and limits
The source supplies a normality qualification and an example in the starred margin. The phrase (équiv. d’homotopie) belongs to the author’s NB note; its truth was not independently established here. The opening (Car is not closed on the page, and the unfinished last sentence is not completed. No check event is recorded because no proof test, independent derivation or mathematical use was performed.

### Blind reading corrections

The definition of X_i-prime uses a dotted equality: its upper point is distinct from the preceding i dot. The explanatory overbrace of the union sits inside the large parentheses. The horizontal handwritten69 belongs to the main restricted-union display, while the NB note and its diagram are slanted; both drafts placed69 in the marginal prose. A possible older t at the initial of proespace and the final words of two cancellations remain uncertain. The prior de-versus-dont row is withdrawn because the final result is uncertainty alone. The opening Car on a, the reminder où on se rappellera, the starred sous réserve que note and the live donc are retained after crop review. The lower replacement sentence follows the canceled line on a normal baseline; unlike the raised distincts and ceux-ci, it has no independent insertion leader.
